description: The digit of the k! place of n. It is floor(n / k!) mod (k+1), and it is 0 when k! exceeds n. The 0! digit is always 0. For 463 the 5! digit is 3 and the 4! digit is 4. k runs from 0 to 20. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/factoradic-digit
